display_name: 身份修正学生网络幅度上限诊断
description: 固定源训练学生权重，比较 1、4、8 倍修正并始终投影到 2% L2 波形上限。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU2 source-only training, CPU 2 threads TF32 disabled; mixed L_s and U_s gradient preflight

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: Fixed source student correction scales and per-record 2% L2 IQ projection; source pilot RX8 records
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels or U_s truth read in source evaluation
data.validation_ref: 384 fixed RX8 source heldout IDs, 64 per impaired view; previously explored, no true-label evaluation
data.leo_config_ref: Fresh source cache epoch21/22/23 training; source cache epoch19 evaluation

permissions.query_use: Source IQ and ground F pseudo targets only; no TX/U_s truth, V or test
permissions.claim_scope: Source source IDs used by F and seen in other channel views, pseudo targets not independent test; bounded correction may exploit classifier
